summary: Small sealed car park in bushland and gardens, no homes nearby.
reasons: Sealed lot straight off the road

drivers.seclusion: Trees and garden beds on all sides; only a small toilet or amenity block beside it.
drivers.access_and_room: Opens directly off the road, no gate seen; about five bays plus a hatched disabled bay, tight for a 7 m van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet two-lane road passes along the west edge; van would sit clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Visitor car park for the gardens; two cars parked, no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Small lot: a long van may take two bays
Disabled bay and hatched area must be kept clear
Slope: edge grades reach 8.6% but the south side is nearly level
sun_shade: Partly shaded by trees on the north and south sides; open to afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: On-site time limits or closing signs
Whether the gardens' gates close the road at night

best_section.where: South side of the small car park, beside the toilet block
